# Airwalk eBook — Creator Programme

> Airwalk (Timișoara, Romania) turns a content creator's knowledge into a finished digital guide (ebook): written in the creator's voice, fully designed for phone and print, put on sale on its own page with automatic payment and delivery, and launched with a ready-made social media kit. No upfront cost for the creator; earnings are split equally. From agreement to launch day takes 3 weeks at most, and about 3-4 hours of the creator's time in total.

The site is available in Romanian (default) and English.

## Programme pages
- [Programul Airwalk pentru creatori (RO)](https://ebook.airwalk.ro/): the full programme in Romanian — the 9 steps, what the creator gets, the launch kit, a case study and FAQ.
- [The Airwalk Creator Programme (EN)](https://ebook.airwalk.ro/en/): the same programme in English.
- [Alătură-te (RO)](https://ebook.airwalk.ro/alatura-te/) / [Join us (EN)](https://ebook.airwalk.ro/en/join/): the entry criteria (15,000-200,000 followers, a recent video over 20,000 views, teaching content, no own paid product on the same topic) and the application form.

## Presentations (PDF)
- [Programul Airwalk pentru creatori (RO, PDF)](https://ebook.airwalk.ro/program/ro/Airwalk-Programul-pentru-creatori-RO.pdf)
- [The Airwalk Creator Programme (EN, PDF)](https://ebook.airwalk.ro/program/en/Airwalk-Creator-Programme-EN.pdf)

## Case study: Aron Bob, The Complete Tesla Guide
- [Ghidul complet Tesla pentru România (RO sales page)](https://ebook.airwalk.ro/aron-bob/ghid-tesla/): 37 pages in 10 chapters, Romanian edition.
- [The Complete Tesla Guide (EN sales page)](https://ebook.airwalk.ro/aron-bob/tesla-guide/): English edition.

## Key facts
- How it works: discovery, agreement, outline, content (WhatsApp voice notes or a fillable PDF), writing, design, sales page and payment, automatic delivery, launch kit.
- Every guide comes in a phone version and an A4 print version.
- The creator can leave within 30 days; a launch price runs for the first week; the creator gets a monthly sales report.
